resource_policy.concurrency_adjustment: increase one step at a time after tablet benchmark; never treat swap as RAM
resource_policy.note: Conservative unactivated starting cap, not final target. Logical agent cycles and QA windows may overlap while the resource broker queues model inference.

qa_ownership.creative_leads: SCRIBE and LENS require independent QA; ChatGPT assigns a reviewer who is not the author.

tasks.title: Opening narrative and Bella Rose direction
acceptance_criteria: Preserves approved opening beats and player-control lock
Defines short and full tour branches with Hustle Towers mandatory first stop
Bella dialogue matches approved personality and is tied to visible scene action
Marks unresolved destination names and canon questions instead of guessing

tasks.title: Opening cinematic shot and camera plan
acceptance_criteria: Covers rain-window opening, train approach, skyline reveal, station, Bella, Towers and tour
Specifies shot intent, camera movement, transitions and approximate timing
Maintains cinematic/guided control until introduction ends
Coordinates camera beats with SCRIBE narrative beats

tasks.title: Rainy rail corridor and city-arrival geography
acceptance_criteria: Defines fictional approach corridor, terrain, water and weather profile
Identifies skyline sightlines and station arrival envelope
Uses approved scale/coordinate conventions or flags missing values
Does not invent final city dimensions or map positions

tasks.title: Station-to-city masterplan and arrival route
acceptance_criteria: Places station, arrival district and Hustle Towers within approved geography
Documents route continuity and skyline composition
Preserves Hustle District and Trapper District identities
Flags unresolved boundaries or map placements

tasks.title: Arrival district and neighborhood identity
acceptance_criteria: Defines arrival district character and neighborhood context
Preserves upscale Hustle District versus gritty Trapper District contrast
Provides visual/material/land-use guidance without changing canon
Identifies venue and destination placement dependencies

tasks.title: Station and Hustle Towers exterior architecture
acceptance_criteria: Defines station and Towers massing, scale, entrances and exterior envelope
Includes courtyard and access interfaces for interiors/navigation
Uses approved world scale and flags unresolved dimensions
Provides modular asset breakdown and integration anchors

tasks.title: Concierge hall, courtyard and Towers interiors
acceptance_criteria: Covers concierge hall, courtyard dressing, lobby, Bella room and player room
Defines circulation, furniture, service points and room-booking location
Matches approved architecture envelope and access points
Lists asset needs and provenance requirements

tasks.title: HIM train, tracks, platform and disembark sequence
acceptance_criteria: Uses HIM for intercity arrival and keeps HCTA as separate local network
Defines train, track, platform, stop and disembark flow
Coordinates passenger route into concierge hall
Identifies train/rail assets and integration interfaces

tasks.title: Station access traffic and vehicle ambience
acceptance_criteria: Defines station access, curbside and roadside ambience
Maintains safe automated traffic and pedestrian separation
Does not invent manual driving as the required travel model
Documents future transport compatibility

tasks.title: Bella Rose and arrival-group character requirements
acceptance_criteria: Defines Bella presentation, rig, animation, facial and gesture requirements
Defines arriving player-group staging and continuity
Preserves approved Bella personality and narrative role
Identifies required character assets and compatibility needs

tasks.title: Passenger crowd and Bella guided-route behavior
acceptance_criteria: Defines passenger flow and crowd navigation from train to concierge hall
Defines Bella escort route to Towers and guided tour path behavior
Includes stuck-route recovery and safe navigation constraints
Maintains no player control until introduction/tour completion

tasks.title: Room booking and guided-tour interactions
acceptance_criteria: Defines player room booking and service interactions
Defines short/full tour selection and destination-by-destination choices
Tracks toured destinations and skip/revisit behavior
Keeps movement/camera control locked until introduction completion

tasks.title: Persistent introduction, tour and start-location state
acceptance_criteria: Defines new-player and returning-player paths
Makes Hustle Towers the mandatory first full-tour stop and default home/start base
Stores tour completion and revisited destinations
Unlocks player control only after Bella closes the introduction

tasks.title: Unreal vertical-slice integration and validation plan
acceptance_criteria: Defines UE5 project/module/Blueprint/Sequencer integration path
Lists approved asset inputs and provenance metadata
Defines a viewable test-map/prototype acceptance checklist
Includes smoke, performance, packaging and QA evidence requirements
